name: Statistical Analysis
description: Generate distributions, compute statistics, run hypothesis tests, and visualize results.

cells.code:
# @param {"type": "slider", "min": 50, "max": 1000, "step": 50, "default": 200}
sample_size = 200
# @param {"type": "number", "min": 50, "max": 200, "default": 100}
mean_control = 100
# @param {"type": "number", "min": 50, "max": 200, "default": 108}
mean_treatment = 108
# @param {"type": "slider", "min": 5, "max": 30, "step": 1, "default": 15}
std_dev = 15
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Generate two sample populations
np.random.seed(123)
group_a = np.random.normal(loc=mean_control, scale=std_dev, size=sample_size)  # Control
group_b = np.random.normal(loc=mean_treatment, scale=std_dev, size=sample_size)  # Treatment
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'group': ['Control'] * sample_size + ['Treatment'] * sample_size,
    'value': np.concatenate([group_a, group_b])
})
print(f"Sample size per group: {sample_size}")
print(f"Control: mean={group_a.mean():.1f}, std={group_a.std():.1f}")
print(f"Treatment: mean={group_b.mean():.1f}, std={group_b.std():.1f}")
print(f"Observed difference: {group_b.mean() - group_a.mean():.2f}")

# Visualize distributions
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

axes[0].hist(group_a, bins=25, alpha=0.7, color='#89b4fa', label='Control')
axes[0].hist(group_b, bins=25, alpha=0.7, color='#a6e3a1', label='Treatment')
axes[0].set_title('Distribution Comparison', color='white')
axes[0].legend()
axes[0].set_xlabel('Value', color='#a6adc8')
axes[0].tick_params(colors='#a6adc8')

axes[1].boxplot([group_a, group_b], labels=['Control', 'Treatment'],
               patch_artist=True,
               boxprops=dict(facecolor='#313244'),
               medianprops=dict(color='#f9e2af'))
axes[1].set_title('Box Plot', color='white')
axes[1].tick_params(colors='#a6adc8')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Two-sample t-test
from scipy import stats

t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(group_a, group_b)
effect_size = (np.mean(group_b) - np.mean(group_a)) / np.sqrt((np.std(group_a)**2 + np.std(group_b)**2) / 2)

print(f"Two-sample t-test")
print(f"="*40)
print(f"t-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}")
print(f"p-value:     {p_value:.6f}")
print(f"Effect size (Cohen's d): {effect_size:.4f}")
print(f"")
if p_value < 0.05:
    print("✓ Result is statistically significant (p < 0.05)")
    print(f"  The treatment group mean ({np.mean(group_b):.1f}) is significantly")
    print(f"  different from the control group mean ({np.mean(group_a):.1f})")
else:
    print("✗ Result is NOT statistically significant")

# @param {"type": "dropdown", "options": ["0.90", "0.95", "0.99"], "default": "0.95"}
confidence_str = "0.95"
# Confidence intervals
from scipy.stats import sem, t
confidence = float(confidence_str)
def confidence_interval(data, confidence=0.95):
    n = len(data)
    mean = np.mean(data)
    se = sem(data)
    h = se * t.ppf((1 + confidence) / 2, n - 1)
    return mean, mean - h, mean + h
mean_a, ci_low_a, ci_high_a = confidence_interval(group_a, confidence)
mean_b, ci_low_b, ci_high_b = confidence_interval(group_b, confidence)
print(f"{confidence*100:.0f}% Confidence Intervals")
print(f"{'='*40}")
print(f"Control:   {mean_a:.2f} [{ci_low_a:.2f}, {ci_high_a:.2f}]")
print(f"Treatment: {mean_b:.2f} [{ci_low_b:.2f}, {ci_high_b:.2f}]")
# Visualize
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
ax.errorbar([mean_a], [0.5], xerr=[[mean_a - ci_low_a], [ci_high_a - mean_a]], fmt='o', color='#89b4fa', markersize=10, capsize=8, label='Control')
ax.errorbar([mean_b], [1.0], xerr=[[mean_b - ci_low_b], [ci_high_b - mean_b]], fmt='o', color='#a6e3a1', markersize=10, capsize=8, label='Treatment')
ax.set_yticks([0.5, 1.0])
ax.set_yticklabels(['Control', 'Treatment'], color='#a6adc8')
ax.set_xlabel('Value', color='#a6adc8')
ax.set_title(f'{confidence*100:.0f}% Confidence Intervals', color='white')
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
